analysis: The code snippet defines `isReadable()` which calls `_impl.canRead()`. According to the provided information, `canRead()` may throw a `SecurityException` (a runtime exception) when a security manager denies read access. The current code does not handle this exception, so it will propagate to the caller. Since `isReadable()` is intended to return a boolean indicating readability, throwing an exception when security denies access is not ideal; the method should instead return `false` to indicate the file is not readable. Therefore, optimizing exception handling by catching the `SecurityException` within this method is appropriate.
